Mob Boss Goons Prompt
Setting and Lighting
Three mob enforcers stand in a dark brick alley at twilight. Vintage 1940s cars sit blurred in the background under a streetlamp glow.

Character 1 (Center)
A bossy goon in a charcoal pinstripe double-breasted suit and matching vest. He wears an open white collared shirt with no tie. A heavy dark trench coat drapes over his shoulders. He has slicked-back greasy hair, a pencil mustache, and holds an unlit cigar.

Character 2 (Left)
A clean-shaven goon wearing a dark brown cable-knit cardigan over a black shirt. He wears a brown Homburg hat and checks a gold wrist watch.

Character 3 (Right)
A serious goon wearing a brown and tan plaid wool vest over a beige shirt with dark pleated pants. He wears a small brown fedora and scans the area.
